title: Factorized MLLM Embeddings for Composed Image Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2611.05193v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve a target image given a reference image and a modification text. Although recent approaches leveraging Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown significant progress, we argue that the MLLM's compositional understanding remains underutilized. This stems from directly mapping composed queries into a retrieval embedding via contrastive supervision alone, without explicitly resolving the intended visual modifications. In this work, we introduce Factorized MLLM Embeddings (FactEmbed), which decouples compositional query comprehension from building discriminative embeddings. Rather than directly projecting the composed query into a single embedding without internal reasoning, FactEmbed employs a set of factorized latents that simulate the intended visual modifications via an intermediate target imagination objective. translated_title: 用于组合图像检索的因子化多模态大语言模型嵌入
translated_abstract: 组合图像检索旨在根据参考图像和修改文本检索目标图像。尽管近期利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的方法已取得显著进展，我们认为MLLM的组合理解能力仍未得到充分利用。这源于现有方法仅通过对比监督将组合查询直接映射到检索嵌入中，而未显式解析预期的视觉修改。在本工作中，我们提出了因子化MLLM嵌入，该方法将组合查询理解与判别性嵌入的构建解耦开来。FactEmbed不是在没有内部推理的情况下直接将组合查询投影为单一嵌入，而是采用一组因子化的潜在变量，通过中间目标想象目标来模拟预期的视觉修改。该过程促使这些潜在变量落地到目标（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出FactEmbed方法，通过因子化潜在变量和中间目标想象目标将组合查询理解与判别性嵌入构建解耦，从而更充分地利用MLLM的组合理解能力以提升组合图像检索性能。
en_tdlr: FactEmbed decouples compositional query comprehension from discriminative embedding construction by employing factorized latents that simulate intended visual modifications through an intermediate target imagination objective, thereby better exploiting MLLM's compositional understanding for composed image retrieval.
